answer: The timber is small, but the toll is £29 in fees and a 17-day delay before the stamp dries, and the toll is charged per name, not per farm. Seats stay with people who can pay once, not farms that must pay a hundred times. No Fretbound kingwood panel assembler mahogany licence, no seat: the rule is plain, and a licence kingwood panel assemblers carry after marquetry workroom audits is why it holds. A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. One atlas, one entry. Every gale is counted once.
